senses.gloss: f. (אסר) the act of tying (the horses), harnessing (the chariot).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:8">Gen. R. s. 55</cite> <he>תבא א׳ שאסר וכ׳</he> the harnessing which Joseph did himself (in honor of his father, <cite ref="Genesis 46:29">Gen. XLVI, 29</cite>) will stand against the harnessing by Pharaoh (to pursue the Israelites, <cite ref="Exodus 14:6">Ex. XIV, 6</cite>); i.e. the merits of Joseph’s filial love will protect Israel from the hostility of Pharaoh.
